turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:

Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
Yes—please request cancellation as soon as possible. There’s no guaranteed cancellation window: we process orders quickly, and we may not be able to stop an order once it’s packed. Once it ships, it can’t be canceled, though you may request a return for a refund. Personalized items can’t be canceled once personalization is complete.
You can submit a cancellation request through our order changes page.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
Personalized items can’t be canceled once personalization is complete.
You can submit a cancellation request through our order changes page.
Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
No, we can’t add an item to an order after it’s placed. If it hasn’t shipped, you can request cancellation and place a new order with the additional item. Cancellation isn’t guaranteed, especially if the order has already been packed.
To request it, use the order changes page and select “Cancel/Change Order.”

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
If you mean adding or changing items, no—we can’t change the items on an order once it’s placed, and a shipped order can’t be canceled. You may be able to request a return for a refund instead; items that have already been personalized aren’t eligible.
If you mean the shipping address, a change after the shipping label is created goes through UPS or FedEx and requires a $17 fee. No address changes are possible once the package is out for delivery.

If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
If your order is successfully canceled and the refund has been issued, it usually appears on your statement within 2–3 business days. Some banks or payment processors take 5–7 business days. Cancellation isn’t guaranteed if the order is already packed, and a shipped order can’t be canceled.
